name: a1222-minimal-e-trixie

build_policy.userspace: Fresh source builds against the restored e500v2/SPE compiler and glibc sysroot
build_policy.bootstrap: minbase-equivalent rebuilt for the selected ABI; dependency closure required
build_policy.package_versions_and_hashes: Pin before execution; these are source-package intent names, not an installable repository

hardware.board: A1222/Tabor; exact original/Plus revision to verify
hardware.cpu: P1022 dual-core e500v2, big-endian PPC32 with SPE
hardware.gpu: AMD Radeon; exact PCI ID required
hardware.boot: USB-first manual trial; verified board firmware format still required

login.password: set during image provisioning; never committed
login.session: X11 via logind/PAM and user D-Bus; retain serial rescue access

project_payloads: board kernel/DTB and verified firmware packaging
fractal test adapted to a normal CLI command
stages.acceptance: Serial login, storage/network enumeration, memory detection and direct SPE correctness; no GUI required
Single user logs in and starts E with terminal/input; complete required EFL/font/codec dependency closure retained
Record DRM driver and GL_VENDOR/RENDERER/VERSION; display glxgears, retain logs and compare software/hardware rendering explicitly
Separate PPC32/SPE C++/Rust/JS-engine build feasibility gate; open local test page, then TLS page; no obsolete browser fallback

radeon.policy: Include only firmware required by identified card and dependencies, respecting firmware license notices; kernel radeon/amdgpu and Mesa r600/radeonsi selected from PCI ID
radeon.xorg: Start with core modesetting driver; add matching xserver-xorg-video-amdgpu or xserver-xorg-video-ati only if required
radeon.llvm: Driver-dependent; do not globally remove LLVM until the selected Mesa driver is qualified

qemu.policy: Separate kernel/device tree and virtio 2D/software Mesa profile; no stock VirGL acceleration claim for big-endian guest

trim_policy: One en_US.UTF-8 locale and one fallback font family initially
No desktop task/metapackage, greeter, browser or VNC in default gl-tests seed
No build toolchain, development headers, docs/manpage bulk or package archive cache in runtime
Keep license notices, required runtime data, NSS/PAM/TLS assets, kernel modules/firmware and error logs
Bound volatile logs; no default disk swap or persistence until reviewed
Do not strip or split GPU modules beyond a recorded dependency/firmware manifest
